assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: a brand-new fictional architectural concept photograph for WOLCO Homes, landscape widescreen 16:9, ideally 2048x1152. This is a fresh composition, not an edit and not a photograph of a completed WOLCO project. Visual family: a low-rise Melbourne courtyard home in warm tactile narrow clay brick with charcoal standing-seam pitched roofs, spotted-gum timber, precise charcoal steel frames, native Australian courtyard planting and clear warm afternoon sunlight. Architecture-editorial photography, spatially believable construction, realistic material scale and excellent buildable geometry. Preserve important architecture within the central 70 percent so a responsive website can crop the edges. No people, text, signage, logos or watermark. No DAMAN reference or media, no curtains, blinds, sheer drapery, generic cream-chair vignette, folded fabric, or rounded travertine island.
Primary composition: a generous architect-designed kitchen seen as a complete interior in the same fictional courtyard-home family. A rectilinear pale warm quartzite island with crisp squared edges, realistic slender slab thickness and a shadow-gap base, precise flat-front spotted-gum cabinetry, an integrated charcoal appliance bank and minimal charcoal accents. A warm exposed clay-brick return wall and a courtyard view through full-height charcoal-framed glazing. The courtyard holds native planting, with natural light making quiet shadows across the worktop. Show the spatial relationship of island, clear working aisle, joinery and courtyard; this is an architectural room, not a countertop product vignette. A restrained domestic setting with the kitchen architecture dominant. Eye-level 28mm rectilinear lens, corrected verticals, tactile but clean surfaces, warm sunlight rather than orange filter. No impossible floating corners, distorted cabinetry or misaligned doors.
assets.visual_review: Complete architectural kitchen with straight squared quartzite island, precise timber joinery, charcoal integrated appliances and visible clay brick courtyard family. Working aisles and supports appear coherent. No rounded island, curtain-focused vignette, people, text/logo or visible watermark. Warm courtyard light is natural-looking.
assets.limitations: A fictional concept; material and structural plausibility is a visual review, not construction engineering certification.
